messages:
Priya Desai: Heads-up I started a PR to reconcile the console dashboard docs with the new schema and to add an observability example tying traces to cost. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/867 — would love a quick pass on the migration bits.
Evan Ortiz: on it. do we have a compatibility shim in the console that still accepts the old shape? if not, we should warn customers in the migration guide.
Nora Williams: there is a temporary patch but it expires next release. the docs should show a jq transform + a sample Python snippet for converting panels.
Priya Desai: adding both. jq snippet I'm drafting:
```bash
jq '.panels |= map(.metrics = (.metrics // .legacy_metrics))' old-dashboard.json > new-dashboard.json
```
Nora Williams: nice. for the cost/latency breakdown section, include a PromQL example customers can drop into Grafana if they export metrics to Prometheus. e.g. average token cost per model: 
```
sum(rate(redwood_token_cost_usd_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(redwood_tokens_total[5m])) by (model)
```
Evan Ortiz: can we also show the trace attribute name so OTLP users can pick it up? propose `redwood.cost.token_usd` as the span attribute. add a tiny Python SDK example that puts it on the span.
Priya Desai: added that. Python snippet in docs/observability/tracing-hooks.md:
```py
from opentelemetry import trace
tracer = trace.get_tracer(__name__)
with tracer.start_as_current_span("generate") as span:
    span.set_attribute("redwood.cost.token_usd", 0.00123)
    # attach latency fields too
    span.set_attribute("redwood.latency.ms", 120)
```
Nora Williams: perfect. one small copy nit: change "token-based cost" -> "per-token cost" in the header. also add a short note about billing rounding (2 decimal places) so customers don't get surprised.
Priya Desai: done — pushed updates. I also added a tiny CI doctest (docs/tests/check_trace_attr.test.js) that curls the preview sandbox and asserts the example trace payload includes `redwood.cost.token_usd`.
docs-bot: Preview build created: https://deploy-preview-867--docs.redwood.ai/ :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Sandbox ready at https://sandbox-867.redwood-inference.internal — example endpoint: `GET /example/trace` (requires token header).
Evan Ortiz: quick question — for the dashboard migration page, maybe include a short mapping table (old field -> new field). you can keep it inline, one-liners.
Priya Desai: added a compact mapping block and an example of a minimal dashboard JSON before/after. planning to merge after one more review from docs or product. thanks! :raised_hands:
